title: Email/import and Email/copy: malformed keywords silently empty instead of error
description: email.rs:865-868 (import) and email.rs:1084-1087 (copy): keywords deserialization uses .ok().unwrap_or_default(). If the client passes invalid keywords (wrong JSON type, unknown keyword format), the error is swallowed and keywords defaults to empty []. The email is stored with no keywords. Should return notCreated with type=invalidProperties, properties=[keywords].
